description:
Check whether a WEE WiLDS unit is available for a date range.

    Args:
        unit: One of "muckle-meadow-pod", "cosie-coorie-pod", "bb".
              The "bb" slug returns per-room availability across all 4 B&B rooms.
        check_in: Arrival date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must not be in the past.
        check_out: Departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be after check_in.

    Returns:
        For pods: {available, blocked_dates_in_range, name, url, ...}.
        For "bb": {rooms: [{room, available, ...}], any_room_available, ...}.
        On invalid input: {error, valid_units}.

check_in.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must not be in the past.
check_in.title: Check In

check_out.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be after check_in.
check_out.title: Check Out

unit.description: Which WEE WiLDS unit: "muckle-meadow-pod" (Muckle Meadow Glamping Pod), "cosie-coorie-pod" (Cosy Coorie Pod) or "bb" (the B&B, all 4 rooms).
unit.title: Unit

name: get_availability
title: Check availability
